_readme: Edit this file to change the studio details and the weekly class timetable. Times are 24h (HH:MM) in the studio timezone. Prices are in the main currency unit (e.g. 15 = 15.00). Each class needs a unique 'key' — if you change a class's time, give it a new key so existing bookings are not affected.
